verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure and hierarchy, but it is mostly a narrowed copy rather than a rearrangement. The pills and their labels are tiny at this size, there is a large dead band between the pills and the RSVP button, and the cramped details column next to the can leaves the right side lopsided. B is broken: the RSVP CTA has become a pill crammed into the top-left cluster with the tags, on top of the sun circle. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the URL, and the date, tagline, time and URL are jammed together with no spacing and mixed alignment. The tagline nearly touches the right edge, and the reading order is scrambled.
